verdict.rationale: MailerSend documents a broad API surface. It covers sending email, SMS and WhatsApp, template CRUD, webhooks, scheduled messages, blocklist and DMARC monitoring, email verification, and account usage and limits. Its MCP server also exposes domains, suppressions, sender identities and users. However, nothing in the evidence claims or shows full UI-to-API parity, and webhook re-enabling is described only as a dashboard action. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), evidence that UI-only features like the drag-and-drop editor and webhook re-enabling are API-accessible, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Create, fetch, update, and delete single templates or a list of templates.

Get your account's plan, email usage, API rate limits and resource limits in one request.
